question: The Defence Budget for the Financial Year 2024-25 constitutes what percentage of the total Union Budget?
solution:
The correct answer is __**12.90%**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Defence Budget** for the **Financial Year 2024-25** constitutes **12.9%** (0.129) of the total **Union Budget**.
 
• This allocation reflects the importance of **national security** and the **modernization of the armed forces**.
 
• The increase in the defence budget is aimed at enhancing the **operational capabilities** of the **Indian Armed Forces**.
 
• It ensures adequate funding for the procurement of **advanced weaponry**, **military infrastructure**, and **research and development** in defence technologies.
 
• This budget allocation also focuses on the welfare of **defence personnel** and their families, providing for **better facilities** and **services**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Union Budget** is an annual financial statement presented by the **Finance Minister** of India, outlining the government's revenue and expenditure for the upcoming financial year.
 
• The **Defence Budget** includes funding for the **Army**, **Navy**, **Air Force**, and other defence-related expenditures.
 
• The allocation to the defence sector has a significant impact on the country's **strategic capabilities** and **defence preparedness**.
 
• The **Ministry of Defence** is responsible for formulating policies and coordinating activities related to national defence.
